setting: Norsk filminnspilling på location — fra kald gryning, gjennom dagen, til wrap i gyllen time
mode: narrativ merkevarefilm (emosjonell historie — teamet er helten, produktet er den stille alliansen)

character.lock: kvinnelig produsent / 1. regiassistent, 30-år, praktisk feltjakke, headset rundt halsen, bærer dagens vekt med rolig varme

vo.tone: varm, intim, cinematisk fortellerstemme — ikke selgende

shots.prompt: a lone producer stands on an empty film location before dawn, breath visible in the cold blue air, looking out over the mountains, unlit gear silhouettes around her — the quiet weight of the day ahead, her face calm but carrying responsibility

close over-the-shoulder, she glances down at the tablet for a moment, then lifts her eyes as the first crew van headlights sweep across the dark location — she is ready, so she can be present; plain green tablet screen
shots.emotion: beredskap · lettelse — hun kan slippe å bekymre seg

shots.prompt: the crew arriving at first light — hugs and handshakes, steam rising from coffee cups, a grip laughing, headlamps and warm breath, the family assembling around the trucks
shots.emotion: tilhørighet · et sett blir en familie

shots.prompt: intimate macro close-ups of the craft: a focus puller's fingers on the lens barrel, warm key light finding an actor's face, a boom held overhead, hands loading a film mag — devotion to the work, shallow depth of field

at the monitor cart as the sun drops fast, the director leans in, the producer beside holds the tablet showing the live take being logged — a held breath, the whole crew focused on one last shot; plain green tablet screen
shots.emotion: press · vi mister lyset — men ingen mister oversikten

shots.prompt: CUT — the exhale: the director and producer share a tired, relieved smile, a crew member claps, warm golden light on their faces, the release of pressure after making the shot
shots.emotion: delt triumf · lettelsen når taket sitter

shots.prompt: golden-hour wrap: the crew as silhouettes packing the camera together, tired and proud, the producer quietly lowers the tablet after sending the delivery, warm backlight — wordmark reveal moment; plain green tablet screen

vo_lines.en: Long before the first shot, someone is already here — carrying the whole day.
vo_lines.no: Lenge før første opptak er noen allerede her — og bærer hele dagen.

vo_lines.en: Everyone already knows where to be. So she can just be present.
vo_lines.no: Alle vet allerede hvor de skal. Så hun bare kan være til stede.

vo_lines.en: One by one they arrive, and a set becomes a family.
vo_lines.no: Én etter én kommer de, og et sett blir en familie.

vo_lines.en: This is where it lives — in the hands, in the light, in the trust between people.
vo_lines.no: Her lever det — i hendene, i lyset, i tilliten mellom mennesker.

vo_lines.en: The light won't wait. But when everyone sees the whole picture, no one is left behind.
vo_lines.no: Lyset venter ikke. Men når alle ser hele bildet, blir ingen etterlatt.

vo_lines.en: And you make the shot — together.
The Role Room. So the team can focus on what matters: the story, and each other.
vo_lines.no: The Role Room. Så teamet kan fokusere på det som betyr mest: historien, og hverandre.
